line_items.reasoning: JPM reported record revenue of $51B in Q2 alone, and with strong Markets revenue of $7.8B (up 10% YoY) and IB fees surging 50% YoY, the firm is tracking well ahead of the ~$90B full-year NII guidance, with no indication of a shortfall.

The balance sheet mix shift in financing businesses was flagged as revenue-neutral and there is no specific Q2 Markets NII figure reported that contradicts the ~$1B guidance; total Markets revenue of $7.8B was strong, consistent with the revenue-neutral framing.
No specific Q2 expense figure was called out as deviating from the ~$91B full-year adjusted expense guidance, and the guidance was reaffirmed this quarter with no upward or downward revision flagged.

Card net charge-offs rose $813M YoY to $2.1B in Q2 and the full-year Card allowance build is now expected slightly above the prior $2B estimate, signaling deterioration beyond prior guidance and raising risk that the <3.5% NCO rate target may be breached.
No deviation from the ~23% effective tax rate guidance was reported in Q2 results, and the guidance was reaffirmed this quarter without any noted discrete items impacting the annual rate.
